title: Network monitoring with Nagios Core for an IT operations centre
challenge: The university's IT operations centre needed continuous visibility of its network and services, and a quick way to get problems to the people who fix them.
actions: Deployed and configured Nagios Core (open source) to monitor the network and related services. Configured the Nagios web interface so the monitoring dashboard is published for operations staff, and built alert notifications to Telegram.
result: Staff in charge receive alerts on Telegram as problems occur, making it easier to coordinate and assign work to network and Wi-Fi technicians.
